text: Long ago, ten suns climbed the sky at once.
asr: Long ago, 10 sons climbed the sky at once.

text: The rivers boiled. The fields cracked. The whole earth began to burn.
Then came Hou Yi, the archer.
asr: Then came Hu Yi, the archer.

text: One arrow for every burning sun.
But the last one, he spared. So the world would have light, and not fire.
One light is enough. Even now, every shadow play burns just one.
